_: Demo data for ?demo=1. The people, finds, swaps and fit checks are invented; vintage.js adds them to the demo boards (boards-fake.js), which already holds three of the finds and one of the swaps by title. The shops are the first six of data/vintage-shops.json and the designs six of all-day/data/merch-designs.json, copied as they are, so the demo never shows an hour or an address that is not real. days is how long a post has left; photo is a placeholder palette. New in: instagram names the invented shop accounts as data/vintage-shops.json names the real ones, and instagramPosts are invented posts in all-day/data/instagram.json's shape; their times move with the reader's clock (anchor). One post is three weeks old and one is from an account that is not a shop: neither shows.

shops.hours: Mon–Wed 10am to 7pm · Thu–Fri 10am to 8pm · Sat 10am to 8:30pm · Sun 10am to 7pm

shops.name: Old Gold
shops.blurb: Vintage and new clothing on Cherry Street: costumes, boots, shoes, wigs and accessories for men and women.

checked.note: Address, phone and what it sells from the shop's own Facebook page (intro and About); it has no website of its own. No weekly hours are readable without a Facebook login, so hours are left empty and the guide says call ahead. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Old Gold node at 151 Cherry St. A 2018 Seven Days item gave 153 Cherry St for the move; the shop's own page says 151.
